excerpt: This hypothetical ultra-rare nuclear decay offers a privileged portal to physics beyond the Standard Model of particle physics. Its observation would constitute the discovery of a matter-creating process ... It would also prove that neutrinos and anti-neutrinos are not two distinct particles.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); M. Agostini, G. Benato, J. A. Detwiler, J. Menendez, F. Vissani
title: Toward the discovery of matter creation with neutrinoless double-beta decay
